app.name: Asset Studio
app.tagline: A local workbench for consistent AI-made visual assets.

search.note: Searching assets, styles and poses arrives with the library (WP-10).

engine.label: Engine status
engine.heldJobs: GPU jobs wait in the queue until the engine runs; you can still queue new ones.
engine.agentNotConfigured: The host agent is not set up, so the engine cannot be started from here. Run the setup script.
engine.agentDown: The host agent is not running on this computer. Start it with the start script.

session.failed: Asset Studio cannot reach its API
session.notConfigured: Asset Studio is not set up yet
session.hint: Start the stack with the start script, then try again.

placeholder.title: {{module}} is not built yet
placeholder.body: This screen arrives in {{wp}}. The navigation, queue indicator and language switch already work.

settings.rest: Data locations, model folders, backup and restore arrive in WP-16.

problems.ENGINE_NOT_CONFIGURED: No ComfyUI folder is configured for the host agent. Run the setup script.
problems.ENGINE_NOT_INSTALLED: ComfyUI is not installed in the configured folder. Run the setup script.
problems.HOST_AGENT_UNAVAILABLE: The host agent is not running on this computer.
problems.HOST_AGENT_NOT_CONFIGURED: The host agent token is not set. Run the setup script.
problems.HOST_AGENT_REJECTED: The host agent rejected the token. Check that both use the same token.
problems.ACTOR_NOT_ALLOWED: Only you can do this, not Claude (MCP).
problems.STYLE_NAME_TAKEN: A style with this name already exists.
problems.CHARACTER_NAME_TAKEN: A character with this name already exists.
problems.REFERENCE_DUPLICATE: This image is already a reference in the project.
problems.MEDIA_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED: Upload a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
problems.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than 30 MB.
problems.IMAGE_SIZE_OUT_OF_RANGE: Each side must be between 64 and 8192 pixels.
problems.LINK_OTHER_PROJECT: The reference belongs to another project.
problems.POSE_TOO_FEW_JOINTS: A pose needs at least 4 visible joints.
problems.POSE_BUILTIN_READONLY: Built-in poses cannot be changed; save a copy.
problems.POSE_DETECTOR_NOT_INSTALLED: Pose detection models are not installed. Install them with the command in the setup guide.
problems.POSE_NOT_FOUND: No person was found. Draw a box around the figure and try again.
problems.REQUEST_INVALID: Some values are not valid. Check the fields and try again.
problems.POSE_MODEL_CORRUPT: A pose detection model file is damaged. Install the models again.

inputs.needsProject: Choose a project in the top bar first.

styles.emptyStyles: No styles yet. A style describes the look all assets share.
styles.pick: Choose a style or character, or create a new one.
styles.archiveConfirm: Archive it? Past generations keep their link.
styles.name: Name
styles.avoidHint: One item per line, e.g. text
styles.testLater: Testing a style generates images; it arrives with Generation Studio (WP-08).
styles.loraLater: Attaching a trained LoRA arrives with the model registry and training (WP-12, WP-13).
styles.pickReferences: Click a reference to link it.
styles.noCandidates: Every reference is already linked. Upload more on the References screen.

references.empty: No references with this role yet. Upload PNG, JPEG or WebP images.
references.pick: Choose a reference to see its details.
references.rules: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to {{mb}} MB, 64–8192 px per side. You can also drop files here.
references.removeHint: The reference leaves the list; styles, characters and past generations keep their link.

poses.noProjectPoses: No poses saved in this project yet.
poses.builtinNote: Built-in poses are read-only; saving makes a copy in the project.
poses.keyboard: Drag joints, or focus one with Tab and move it with the arrow keys (Shift for bigger steps).
poses.name: Name
poses.tooFew: A pose needs at least {{n}} visible joints.
poses.detectHint: Pick a reference image. The skeleton opens in the editor, where you check it and save it.
poses.boxReady: Box drawn. Detect in the box, or draw it again.
poses.boxHint: Drag a box around the figure.
poses.manualFallback: You can also set the pose by hand in the editor.
